feature: XiaoYu switchable Qwen clone voice bundle

reuse_decision.voice_store_and_picker: N.E.K.O existing character voice storage and source-first picker remain authority
reuse_decision.realtime_synthesis: N.E.K.O existing qwen3.8-omni-flash-realtime transport remains authority; only the paired cloned voice id is passed to session.update
reuse_decision.text_synthesis: Thin HTTP adapter to Alibaba Model Studio Qwen-Audio TTS; no second TTS engine, no new voice database
reuse_decision.clone_creation: Official Alibaba HTTP customization endpoint used once; no shared DashScope SDK upgrade
reuse_decision.why_not_upgrade_shared_sdk: Installed DashScope 1.27.7 already supports current Omni realtime. Its legacy tts_v2 VoiceEnrollmentService rejected qwen3.8 Omni enrollment; upgrading the shared SDK could affect existing CosyVoice paths, while the official HTTP creation API worked directly.

bundle.fallback_on_realtime_model_mismatch: external Qwen-Audio text TTS; never leak the Omni clone to an incompatible realtime model

live_cutover.picker: existing N.E.K.O source-first voice picker; display_name is used; CosyVoice entries remain present
